definitions.explanation: A deep, dark shade of blue. One of the traditional Japanese colors, historically associated with indigo dyeing. Commonly used for school uniforms and business attire in Japan.

examples.japanese: {紺色|こんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I'm wearing a navy blue suit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紺色|こんいろ}だった。
examples.english: The school uniform was navy blue.

examples.japanese: {紺色|こんいろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦フォーマル→フォーマル：11294_foomaru⟧な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひとつ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Navy blue is considered one of the most formal colors in Japan.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as a no-adjective: {紺色|こんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Often shortened to ⟦{紺|こん}→紺：03885_kon⟧ in casual speech or compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紺色|こんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧: navy blue suit
- {紺色|こんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧: navy blue uniform
- ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧{紺色|こんいろ}: deep navy blue

CULTURAL NOTE:
{紺色|こんいろ} is one of the traditional Japanese colors ({和色|わしょく}), produced through repeated indigo (⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧) dyeing. It has long been a popular color in Japan and is sometimes called "⟦{紺|こん}→紺：03885_kon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{出|い}でて⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧し," a proverb meaning the student surpasses the master.
